explanation: Benoist (arXiv:1602.07330, Question 0.2): 'Do we have p(R(X1,...,Xn)) = 2^n?', with p(K) the smallest p such that every sum of squares in K is a sum of p squares (Pfister 1971 §4 Problem 1). pythagorasBounds K = {p | every sum of squares is a sum of p squares}, so IsLeast (pythagorasBounds ℝ(X1..Xn)) (2^n) is p = 2^n; MvRatFunc (Fin n) ℝ is the rational function field. The statement for all n is the yes/no form of the question. Faithful.
